findings.note: Official Oilers preview: Hyman missed the last game with a migraine that affected his vision, and Nugent-Hopkins is likely back. Edmonton ranks 3rd in goals per game at 3.85 but 4th-fewest in shots on goal per game at 24.6, which suggests its scoring depends on finishing and may not hold up.

NHL Gamecenter shows strong power plays on both sides (VGK 27.3%, EDM 32.6%), penalty kills ranked 16th–17th, and Vegas goalies Hart and Hill at .886 and .898 save percentages. These point to a game that could go over. Starting goalies are not confirmed.

The Covers betslip lists trends: the Over is 4-0 in Vegas's last 4 games and 8-1 after Vegas scores 5 or more goals. These are short-sample betting trends, not an expert pick or a projection on the 6.5 total.
